faq.q: What did houses in Holly sell for?
faq.a: 22 houses sold in Holly between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,417,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Holly?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.4% of the last list price (14% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Holly sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 22 houses that sold in Holly went for between $1,197,375 and $1,571,250, around a median of $1,417,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Holly sell above asking price?
faq.a: 14% of the 22 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.4% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Holly?
faq.a: The median year built was 1988 for the 22 houses sold in Holly.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Holly usually have?

blocks.text: What Holly houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

22 houses sold in Holly with a median price of $1,417,000 (the middle half sold between $1,197,375 and $1,571,250), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 96.4% of the last list price; 14% sold above list. They had a median $559 per square foot, a median year built of 1988 and a median lot of 5,878 square feet.
How Holly compares with the rest of Ladner
The median house in Holly sold for $1,417,000, 6% above the Ladner median of $1,340,000 across 117 sales. Holly houses took a median 18 days to sell, against 16 days for Ladner as a whole.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a community is listed only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.
